requestBody.occasion: thank-you for supporting a small business
requestBody.tone: warm, sincere, polished, grateful, not salesy
requestBody.style: premium small-business editorial stationery: warm citrus, cream, deep teal, soft gold, handmade local-shop texture

CustomCard needs editable copy overlays, print-safe margins, persistence, and human review before external sharing.
